description: Create an ephemeral child handle of this account (@account.<your-name>-<name>) for a chat/session that needs its own inbox. Returns the key once and the MCP/HTTP snippet. Inherits contacts; disappears after ttl_days (default 7) unused; the owner sees and removes it in settings. Up to 10 a day per account.

name.description: lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, e.g. errors

name: aicq_spawn
